summary: This session shipped 5c-iii-a (delivery acks), 5c-iii-b (multi-device sync), and 5d (Tier V device-verified presence) — plus a Phase 5f quorum-keys roadmap brief, the verify-page polish for the wife-test, and the four-cut org-mode UI roadmap that landed earlier in the same thread. Phase 5d closes with the new src/features/presence/ feature: WebAuthn passkey enrollment + assertion, geolocation wrapper, device-passkey + tier-v-presence credential builders, and a MarkPresenceModal lazy-loaded from HomeScreen. The Identity tab grows a Presence section. Honest about limits per the spec — 'to the best of the device's ability.'

why.text: Operator's standing directive: 'as long as you're knocking something out and you're grounded, I think you're doing a fantastic job.' Locked sequence per Phase 5f roadmap brief: 5c-iii → 5d → 5e → 5f. Knocked out the entire 5c-iii pair plus 5d in this session.

[P-002] 5c-iii-b multi-device sync shipped at 114447d — self-CC envelopes encrypted to own pubkey; inbox auto-holds on senderPubkey == own. [P-003] Phase 5d Tier V shipped at 939ee51 — WebAuthn passkey + Geolocation + signed event; modal lazy-loaded; Identity tab Presence section. [P-005] Verify-page wife-test polish at 530e946 — red on tamper, plain-English bridge, collapsible How-it-works. Recommend a sketch at briefs/2026-05-24-shamir-cascade-recovery-roadmap.md before code lands.

uncertainty: WebAuthn enrollment + assertion are unit-untested because jsdom does not implement them; the API surface follows the standard contract and works under operator field testing. The presence verifier flow (independent verification of the WebAuthn assertion signature against a published enrollment public key) is deferred — leaves are recorded for the future verifier. Two-device field test of multi-device sync against real Nostr relays is the open evidence question.
